model_rule: .converge/playbooks/ is source blueprint; .converge/journal/ is executable run state/evidence. Fix source or loader/compiler behavior; do not hand-edit manifest.json or runstate.json.

findings.gap: executeTask prefers task content from runstate.json (compiled runtime state) over the authoritative playbook source TASK.md. If compilation embeds stale content, the runtime silently uses it instead of re-reading the blueprint source.
findings.evidence: run/index.ts line 968-970: 'Prefer task content from runstate.json (embedded at compile time). Fall back to filesystem TASK.md only when task_def is unavailable.' Lines 980-983 check tdPrompt/tdBody from node.taskDef first, only falling to Unit.fromPath(absPath) if those are absent.
findings.correction: Reverse the preference order: read TASK.md from disk first as the authoritative blueprint, then fall back to compiled task_def. Add a freshness check comparing TASK.md mtime against compile timestamp in runstate metadata.
findings.test_to_write: tests/compile/blueprint-authority.test.ts — test that modifying a playbook TASK.md and re-executing a previously compiled task uses the updated source content, not stale compiled content

findings.gap: compilePlaybook hardcodes the journal path convention ('.converge/journal/') instead of using getTargetDir(). The same hardcoding appears at lines 237, 244, and 1155. If the journal convention changes, every raw string must be found and updated.
findings.evidence: run/index.ts line 1243: join(projectDir, '.converge', 'journal', playbookName, 'manifest.json') — getTargetDir() exists at journal/structure.ts:78 but is not used here
findings.correction: Replace all raw '.converge/journal/' path construction in run/index.ts with calls to getTargetDir(projectDir, playbookName)
findings.test_to_write: tests/journal/path-consistency.test.ts — test that changing the journal root via CONVERGE_TARGET_DIR env var is respected by compilePlaybook

findings.gap: ingestSpawnedChildrenFromRunstate constructs journal paths manually from raw strings instead of using getTargetDir() or PlaybookPaths.journal. Scatters the path convention across the framework.
findings.evidence: dag-tree.ts lines 330-336: path.join(this.projectDir, '.converge', 'journal', playbookName, 'executions') — hardcoded string split across separate join arguments
findings.correction: Use getTargetDir(projectDir, playbookName) to derive the journal root, appending 'executions' only if that subdirectory actually exists in the current structure
findings.test_to_write: tests/dag/spawned-children-reload.test.ts — verify spawned children are discovered regardless of journal root configuration
